thread:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: INCIDENT#APIGW-5XX-SPIKE — prod-us-east. Alert rate ~1.2k/min, 5xx ratio rising across gateway nodes :rotating_light:
pagerbot: auto-assign -> jordan (oncall). Escalation policy: oncall -> secondary if not ack in 2m.
jordan: I’m on it, acked. looking at dashboards now.
jordan: quick note — customers reporting failures for /v1/generate and /v1/stream, errors look like 502/504 from the upstream model pool.
devon: I can pick this up if you want me to own mitigation, jordan. heading to runbook now.
jordan: please take. handing off — devon is primary for mitigation. I'll stay on thread for context. :thumbsup:
devon: reading runbook 'api-gateway-5xx' — first step is to verify K8s ingress health and edge LB. grabbing logs.
maria: noticed an autoscaler misfire on dedicated-pool-a causing hot nodes to spike memory then fail — appears to coincide with a 2026-03-17 03:21 deploy? correlating.
devon: ok quick mitigation option: flip traffic away from dedicated-pool-a to dedicated-pool-b, and enable temporary routing backfill to reserve capacity. Will run hotroute toggle.
ryan: if you flip route, be prepared to throttle burst for low-tier customers. notify support.
devon: running command: ```sh
# toggle hot route to pool-b
redwoodctl route update --service api-gateway --hotroute=dedicated-pool-b --reason "5xx spike mitigation"
```
devon: executed, returning 202. Watching error rate.
jordan: seeing 5xx rate drop in 30s -> 200s. nice.
maria: memory OOMs on pool-a nodes stopping, but pool-b has headroom. autoscaler set to 0.5 cooldown; increasing to 3m to avoid thrash.
devon: applied autoscaler cooldown tweak: ```PATCH /infra/autoscaler/DEDICATED_POOL_A
cooldown_seconds: 180```
devon: error rate down to baseline, 5xx ~0.5% of traffic now.
ryan: customer-support, ping top 3 affected customers with ETA and mitigation summary.
jordan: quick customer impact summary: ~1% of total requests affected during 03:20-03:26 window; peak lasted ~3 minutes; no data loss, degraded responses for some enterprise accounts.
devon: creating a short incident note and assigning postmortem to me + maria. tagging SRE and Product for impact review.
incidentbot: Note saved: INCIDENT#APIGW-5XX-SPIKE — mitigation: routed to dedicated-pool-b; autoscaler cooldown adjusted; owner: devon.
jordan: closing PD page in 5m if metrics stay stable. please post any regression updates here.
maria: will pull heap dumps and attach to the postmortem doc. initial hypothesis: bad rollout triggered memory regression on pool-a image.
devon: follow-up action items: revert faulty deploy in pool-a, run canary with increased memory limit, improve autoscaler backoff handling.
jordan: thanks team. good handoff and quick mitigation — we should mention the hotroute toggle in the runbook for future. :heavy_check_mark:
ryan: filing customer note draft now.
devon: closing thread — will open postmortem doc and link once ready.
